sources.title: How to carry out a COSHH risk assessment
sources.actualReading: Actual web.run page read during this review: Identify the hazards, Assess the risks, Control the risks, Elimination, Systems of work and Personal protective equipment.
sources.ownParaphrase: Hazard assessment should consider who may be exposed and by which routes. Avoiding use can remove use-related exposure; storage and route-specific controls still matter. PPE does not automatically address every exposure route.
sources.scopeLimit: Used only to independently check general scientific exposure/control principles. No UK legal rule is applied to a German household or learner. No real cleaner, composition, SDS or certificate has been verified.
